patches.reason: Live proactive delivery auto-started a text session, then self-blocked because start_session refreshed last_user_activity_time. After an internal auto-start, the claim recheck must use genuine user engagement instead of lifecycle activity.

Live physical-microphone acceptance was blocked because the active Full Chat surface exposed no visible voice control even though N.E.K.O's native microphone/realtime runtime was present. Add only a visible bridge to the existing #micButton.

Live privacy-safe synthetic-audio E2E reproduced a Qwen3.8 native realtime failure: semantic_vad accepted session.update and 231 audio appends but emitted no speech/transcript/reply before buffer clear. The same PCM with server_vad emitted speech_started, completed transcription and a completed assistant response. Scope the fallback to qwen3.8 only.

Live RC voice use showed the bounded microphone ingress queue reaching 1.5s and clearing 200 frames while a proactive realtime media/response transaction held the shared turn-admission lock. Existing user-priority gates depend on realtime _user_recent_activity_time, but native PCM only updated it inside the blocked worker. Publish the same raw-RMS activity signal immediately after ingress validation and before queueing; provider audio, VAD, DSP, transcript and queue semantics remain unchanged.

Live desktop use reproduced two character-switch recovery failures. First, an in-flight switch could drop a newer A→B→A intent. Second, and decisive for the observed blank XiaoYu avatar, a failed target-model load restored lanlan_name to XiaoYu after the old VRM had already been removed; the subsequent real YUI→XiaoYu event was then incorrectly discarded by same-character dedupe. Preserve the latest pending target and make same-character dedupe conditional on the configured VRM instance actually existing, so missing VRM state is treated as recovery.

Live use and follow-up debugging showed that an independent speech-mute bit could publish assistant text while suppressing its audio. The owner contract is simpler: quiet suppresses the whole reply; any admitted normal reply text must stay paired with TTS. Reuse the existing XiaoYu state-file bridge but move admission before the text/TTS split, remove audio-only TTS/send gates, and keep exact whole-utterance commands only as a synchronous race-closing override. Persistent intent remains owned by the private interaction-policy plugin.

Repeated isolated qwen3.8 probes proved auto-selection skipped one negative recent-activity wording. Revalidation showed the provider's native forced function call works when reasoning_effort=none. Add only a generic opt-in first-round route bridge: the private launcher supplies the registered tool name/regex/reasoning override, N.E.K.O forwards provider-native tool_choice on the first OpenAI-compatible round, and immediately restores normal tool/reasoning settings after that round. No local tool pre-execution or XiaoYu-specific wording lives in N.E.K.O.

The legacy XiaoYu Qwen3-TTS VC model is retired, but the preferred reference audio remains available. Reuse N.E.K.O's existing character voice store/picker and native Qwen3.8 Omni realtime transport, and expose Alibaba Qwen as a first-class qwen_bundle provider. One reference sample creates paired official Qwen-Audio 3.1 TTS and Qwen3.8 Omni clone IDs stored in one existing voice record. Preview, ordinary text TTS and Realtime all read the same per-voice speech_rate; text TTS and Realtime reuse existing audio processing to apply pitch-preserving tempo, while rate changes retire only the matching active TTS runtime. CosyVoice remains intact as a selectable fallback; no second voice database, transport or DSP engine is introduced.

Live use reproduced a mini-game invitation while the owner was actively gaming, showing that early ActivitySnapshot classification alone is not a sufficient interruption authority. Reuse Windows SHQueryUserNotificationState in the existing SystemSignalCollector, preserve the native ActivitySnapshot, keep canned game invites leisure-only, and recheck the latest native snapshot again inside prepare_proactive_delivery immediately before claim. Windows BUSY/fullscreen/presentation/quiet states veto every nonessential proactive delivery; native busy states veto ambient/entertainment delivery, with focused_work allowed only for the dedicated work-break reminder. Optional providers are now observed in shadow through N.E.K.O's existing PluginCatalog/PluginRunner and hidden plugin entries; they cannot alter or delay the native verdict. No new plugin host, polling loop, game database, or model call.

Live watchdog stacks exposed synchronous startup/event-loop hot paths across main, agent and memory processes: first OpenAI/plugin imports, filesystem/model discovery, config/storage resolution and lazy HTTP/TLS client construction. Reuse N.E.K.O's existing background/off-loop patterns, isolated plugin-server thread, native TokenTracker, get_internal_http_client and external pooled client; use asyncio.to_thread only at blocking boundaries, including first shared-client resolution. No XiaoYu HTTP pool, SSLContext cache, plugin host, model runtime or second lifecycle authority is introduced.

Close the native task-result durable effect-state gap by extending the existing NekoClaw ledger/outbox with handoff, exact claim, uncertain-effect and terminal sent semantics. No second ledger/outbox is introduced.

Connect the existing durable outbox delivery identity to N.E.K.O native callback acknowledgement and main-process epoch reconciliation so transport acceptance is not mistaken for visible effect completion.

Preserve a known plugin run with unreadable terminal status as effect-unknown rather than confirmed failure, using existing RunOutcome unknown, blocked commission and gateway result semantics to prevent blind duplicate execution.
Wire NekoClaw's existing stable host call identity into the plugin server's native RunCreateRequest.idempotency_key and retry only ambiguous create outcomes with that same key.

policy: Prefer config -> external plugin -> adapter -> narrowly-scoped core patch. Keep every patch tied to a concrete live acceptance gap and remove it when upstream behavior makes it unnecessary.
